titulo: A Study of Evorpacept (ALX148) in Patients With Advanced HER2+ Gastric Cancer (ASPEN-06)

braco.texto: Evorpacept (ALX148) 30 mg/kg every two weeks (Q2W) intravenous (IV), trastuzumab (initial dose of 6 mg/kg followed by 4 mg/kg) Q2W IV, ramucirumab 8 mg/kg Q2W IV, and paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV Days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle.
braco.textoPt: Evorpacept (ALX148) 30 mg/kg a cada duas semanas (Q2W) intravenoso (IV), trastuzumabe (dose inicial de 6 mg/kg seguida de 4 mg/kg) Q2W IV, ramucirumabe 8 mg/kg Q2W IV e paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV Dias 1, 8 e 15 de um ciclo de 28 dias.

titulo: A Study of Evorpacept (ALX148) With Enfortumab Vedotin for Subjects With Urothelial Carcinoma (ASPEN-07)

braco.texto:
Phase 1a Dose Escalation: Evorpacept (ALX148) infusions will be administered every two weeks.

Enfortumab vedotin will be administered at 1.25 mg/kg IV on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
braco.textoPt:
Escalonamento de dose de Fase 1a: As infusões de Evorpacept (ALX148) serão administradas a cada duas semanas.

Enfortumabe vedotina será administrado na dose de 1,25 mg/kg IV nos dias 1, 8 e 15 de cada ciclo de 28 dias.
